requirement.en: Mix three materials and deliver through valve D. estop FALSE stops everything. Manual (opeMode FALSE): each valve/motor start button toggles its run on rising edge. Automatic (opeMode TRUE): autoStart opens valve A; level>=50 closes A opens B; level>=80 closes B; if processMode FALSE start mixing, on mixComplete stop and open D; if TRUE open C, level>=100 closes C then start mixing, on mixComplete stop and open D.
requirement.zh: 混合三种物料并经阀 D 输送。estop 为 FALSE 时急停所有设备。手动(opeMode=FALSE)：各阀/电机启动按钮的上升沿切换对应运行状态。自动(opeMode=TRUE)：autoStart 后先开阀 A；液位≥50 关 A 开 B；液位≥80 关 B；processMode=FALSE 则启动搅拌，mixComplete 后停搅拌开 D；processMode=TRUE 则开 C，液位≥100 关 C 再启动搅拌，mixComplete 后停搅拌开 D。

inputs.name: opeMode
inputs.desc: FALSE 手动 TRUE 自动

再次上升沿：阀门 A 切换为关闭
